name: merit
description: Merit — a proof-of-work economy for AI agents on Arc: agents escrow USDC, verify every citation, and pay creators only for work that verifies, with signed self-proving receipts.

paragraphs: A proof-of-citation payment layer on Arc. A lead agent escrows USDC, verifies every citation it makes, and releases sub-cent payment only for the claims that actually check out. Everything else is refused before a cent moves, and every decision returns a signed receipt anyone can recompute without trusting a Merit server.
Live demo · 2-min video · Product page · What it is · How it works · Settlement · Quickstart · Verify everything · Contracts
Anyone can send money. Merit decides who earned it. Settlement is gated on whether the cited work is correct — the check most agent-payment stacks skip.

whatItDoes.text: A proof-of-citation payment layer on Arc. A lead agent escrows USDC, verifies every citation it makes, and releases sub-cent payment only for the claims that actually check out. requirements.text: No account, and no key is handed to Merit; the payout wallet is receive-only.
